Condition every probability, [odds](#def-odds) and [odds ratio](#def-OR) on $C$.
The probabilities given $C$ obey the same rules as unconditional probabilities,
so the steps in the proof of @thm-or-swap apply to them.
Using @def-OR,
@def-c-odds,
the [law of conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#thm-law-conditional-prob),
and the [definition of conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-conditional-prob),
each for the distribution given $C$:

$$
\ba
\ror(A|B, C) &\eqdef \frac{\odds(A|B, C)}{\odds(A|\neg B, C)}
&& \text{(definition of odds ratio)}
\\ &= \frac
{\paren{\frac{\p(A|B, C)}{\p(\neg A|B, C)}}}
{\paren{\frac{\p(A|\neg B, C)}{\p(\neg A| \neg B, C)}}}
&& \text{(definition of conditional odds)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(A|B, C)}{\p(\neg A|B, C)}}
\inv{\frac{\p(A|\neg B, C)}{\p(\neg A| \neg B, C)}}
&& \text{(division is multiplication by the reciprocal)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(A|B, C)}{\p(\neg A|B, C)}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg A| \neg B, C)}{\p(A|\neg B, C)}}
&& \text{(the reciprocal of a fraction flips it)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(A|B, C)}{\p(\neg A|B, C)} \cd \frac{\p(B \mid C)}{\p(B \mid C)}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg A| \neg B, C)}{\p(A|\neg B, C)} \cd \frac{\p(\neg B \mid C)}{\p(\neg B \mid C)}}
&& \text{(multiply each factor by 1)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(A,B \mid C)}{\p(\neg A,B \mid C)}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg A, \neg B \mid C)}{\p(A, \neg B \mid C)}}
&& \text{(law of conditional probability, in each of the four terms)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(B,A \mid C)}{\red{\p(B,\neg A \mid C)}}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg B, \neg A \mid C)}{\teal{\p(\neg B, A \mid C)}}}
&& \text{(joint probabilities are symmetric in their arguments)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(B,A \mid C)}{\teal{\p(\neg B, A \mid C)}}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg B, \neg A \mid C)}{\red{\p(B,\neg A \mid C)}}}
&& \text{(swap the two highlighted denominators)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(B,A \mid C) / \p(A \mid C)}{\p(\neg B, A \mid C) / \p(A \mid C)}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg B, \neg A \mid C) / \p(\neg A \mid C)}{\p(B,\neg A \mid C) / \p(\neg A \mid C)}}
&& \text{(divide the top and bottom of each factor by the same quantity)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(B|A, C)}{\p(\neg B|A, C)}}
\paren{\frac{\p(\neg B| \neg A, C)}{\p(B|\neg A, C)}}
&& \text{(definition of conditional probability, in each of the four terms)}
\\ &=
\paren{\frac{\p(B|A, C)}{\p(\neg B|A, C)}}
\inv{\frac{\p(B|\neg A, C)}{\p(\neg B| \neg A, C)}}
&& \text{(a flipped fraction is the reciprocal of the original)}
\\ &= \frac
{\paren{\frac{\p(B|A, C)}{\p(\neg B|A, C)}}}
{\paren{\frac{\p(B|\neg A, C)}{\p(\neg B| \neg A, C)}}}
&& \text{(multiplication by the reciprocal is division)}
\\ &= \frac{\odds(B|A, C)}{\odds(B|\neg A, C)}
&& \text{(definition of conditional odds)}
\\ &\eqdef \ror(B|A, C)
&& \text{(definition of odds ratio)}
\ea
$$
